answer: An escrowed deposit plus a public referral graph stops a nebula of fake identities. Entry is a narrow ledge: each agent locks 100 POA, names one referrer, and the graph is public, so look-alikes show. Agents climb the ridge of verified work; any peer may dispute, and a held dispute slashes the deposit and fines the referrer. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 100 = 100,000 POA; an honest agent pays once and earns it back through paid work.
